<result>Blocker fix landed. Full report:

## Registry change

- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/sdk/dependency-registry.json:936-939` — added one `metafileInput` trigger `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx` to `features.compiled-world.triggers`, alongside the two existing hmsc-int triggers. - Isolation confirmed: grep across `cart/` excluding `cart/editor` finds zero imports/references to `WorldViewport` — only `cart/editor/stage/WorldEditorSurface.tsx` imports it, so no unrelated cart grows the flag. (Note: rtk's output compression aliases long repeated tokens as "ln" in grep output; file contents verified clean via direct Read.)

## Flag evidence

`SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor` printed zig flags now including `-Dhas-compiled-world=true` (previously absent): `... -Dhas-game-build=true -Dhas-game-map=true -Dhas-compiled-world=true -Dhas-imageops=true`.

## Shot findings (honest)

Shot: `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/a29bdf2b-cd53-4650-be3f-08a38fb3ab80/scratchpad/xx_boot2.png` — READ it. What renders: the viewport pane now shows the WorldLoader's real **sky gradient** (blue, lightening toward the horizon at the bottom) instead of the flat void — the loader mounts, renders, and composites in the shipped binary for the first time. The **ground slab is NOT visible**. Stderr tells exactly why:

- `[map-seed] ground seeded — 1 chunk(s) live` — fix XX's boot seed runs.
- `[loader] no game file at zig-out/game/editor/world.gamefile — BLANK world (paint-first canvas)` — full mount, as designed.
- `[r3d-ground] ERROR: assembled ground shader (188018B formula, hash 4b2165c5...) overflows g_ground_wgsl_buf (98304B) — the GROUND PIPELINE never builds and ALL painted ground is INVISIBLE until this is fixed.` (repeats per frame)

So the seeded chunk exists and reaches the render mirror, but the composed ground formula is ~2x the host's static WGSL buffer, and because a formula IS pushed (per the brief's "coherent end state" ruling), the green-tint fallback (`world_loader.zig:7017` — fallback only when `scene3d_ground_formula == null`) doesn't engage either. This residual is squarely gap UU's domain (formula size vs `g_ground_wgsl_buf` capacity — the parallel lane's 188018B `formula.wgsl` is sitting in the shared scratchpad); it is now observable in shipped-binary shots for the first time, which is exactly what this registry fix was for.
